deploymentMode: live local isolated deployment (dev server, single CLI process)

sdk.installed: isolated harness dir (~/.de1r/harness), NOT the repo

footprint.note: dev server = single CLI process (embeds server + UI + metrics listener); the worker is a separate node process running the AutoLoop-equivalent graph code. Production adoption would additionally require the DB tier (SQLite dev / Postgres / MySQL) and namespace/upgrade management.

operationalComplexity.upgrade: CLI binary swap; server version pinned to CLI bundle; workflow versioning via worker version sets (operational burden)
operationalComplexity.vsExisting: STACK_A adds zero services; Temporal adds 1 server process + DB + 3 listeners + SDK + worker lifecycle
